title: VoC Marketing Manager – Sell-Side
description:
**Job Description:** 
 Marketing Manager – VOC
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



 Coalition Greenwich is the leading global provider of data, analytics and insights to the ﬁnancial services industry.  We specialize in providing unique high value data and actionable recommendations to help our clients improve their business results.
 



**Position Overview** 




 The Marketing Manager will support the execution of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels, including digital, email, content, event marketing, and sales enablement. The ideal candidate has 3 to 5 years of experience in marketing, is highly organized, and is passionate about leveraging data and technology to optimize marketing performance. This role requires creativity, strong analytical skills, and an ability to collaborate with various stakeholders to enhance brand presence and engagement.
 








 Principal Responsibilities:
 



  
 



 Ø Digital \& Social Media Marketing
 



 ·        Assist in the development and execution of digital marketing campaigns across paid and organic channels to drive traffic and engagement.
 



 ·        Manage social media accounts, creating and scheduling content across LinkedIn, Twitter, and other relevant platforms.
 



 ·        Monitor and analyze social media performance, providing insights and recommendations for optimization.
 



  
 



 Ø Email Marketing
 



 ·        Support the creation and execution of email marketing campaigns, including newsletters, product announcements, and event invitations.
 



 ·        Optimize email templates for engagement, deliverability, and conversion.
 



 ·        Analyze email campaign performance, track key metrics, and suggest improvements.
 



  

  
 



  
 



 Ø Content Marketing
 



 ·        Collaborate with internal teams to create and distribute compelling marketing content (blog posts, reports, whitepapers, infographics, and videos).
 



 ·        Optimize content for SEO and distribute it effectively across digital channels.
 



 ·        Assist in managing and updating website content to ensure consistency and relevance.
 



  
 



 Ø Sales Enablement \& Marketing Collateral
 



 ·        Develop and maintain marketing collateral, including brochures and one\-pagers.
 



 ·        Assist in the creation and refinement of pitch decks and presentations.
 



 ·        Ensure all sales enablement materials are up to date, visually appealing, and aligned with brand guidelines.
 



 ·        Work closely with the relationship managers to understand their needs and provide marketing assets that help drive client engagement and conversions.
 



  
 



 Ø Marketing Analytics \& Optimization
 



 ·        Track, analyze, and report on marketing KPIs and campaign performance.
 



 ·        Assist in A/B testing initiatives to optimize campaign performance.
 



  
 



 Ø Event \& Webinar Support
 



 ·        Assist in the planning, promotion, and execution of virtual and in\-person events, including webinars and industry conferences.
 



 ·        Coordinate marketing collateral and promotional materials for events.
 



  
 



  

  
 



  
 



**Qualifications/ skills** 




 ·        5\-8 years of experience in marketing, preferably in B2B or financial services.
 



 ·        Strong understanding of digital marketing, social media marketing, email marketing, and content marketing best practices.
 



 ·        Hands\-on experience with marketing automation, CMS, and CRM tools.
 



 ·        Proficiency in social media platforms, Google Analytics, and SEO principles.
 



 ·        Experience in creating sales enablement materials, such as brochures, pitch decks, and sales presentations.
 



 ·        Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 



 ·        Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
